# qbittorrent_webui_endpoint (Resource)

Explicit maintenance of the qBittorrent WebUI listener. A changed listener requires post_update_url and uses a separate candidate connection to verify the result. If verification fails, update the provider URL manually and reapply only after checking the server; the mutation is never replayed. Import ID: application. Apply this separately from ordinary preferences and update the provider endpoint after a successful transition.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `post_update_url` (String) Target WebUI URL used only for the bounded post-update reconnect. Required whenever any listener field changes; set the provider URL to this value in the next maintenance operation.
- `use_https` (Boolean) Whether the WebUI uses HTTPS. TLS verification remains enabled for candidate connections.
- `web_ui_address` (String) Server bind address: * or an IPv4/IPv6 address.
- `web_ui_https_cert_path` (String) Server-side certificate path; certificate contents are never managed.
- `web_ui_https_key_path` (String) Server-side private key path; key contents are never managed.
- `web_ui_port` (Number) WebUI TCP port, 1 through 65535.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
